# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Feb 18, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on significant updates to `op-reth`, including porting historical proofs and updating Reth dependencies. Key bug fixes addressed interop header lookup and CI workflow issues. Progress was also made on `op-supernode` wiring and blob handling in Kona.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### `op-reth` Enhancements and Dependency Updates
A major feature was added to `op-reth` by porting historical proofs from `op-rs/op-reth` ([#19191](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19191)). This involved a substantial update to Reth to revision `2c5d00f` and bumping Alloy dependencies ([#19194](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19194), [#19237](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19237)).

### Interoperability and Supernode Improvements
Bug fixes were implemented for Kona proofs, specifically addressing interop header_by_number lookup for blocks within the current history window ([#19230](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19230)). Additionally, `op-supernode` wiring was updated ([#19110](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19110)), and a new test was added to devstack for interop FP trace extension action ([#19221](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19221)).

### Infrastructure and CI Fixes
A critical CI bug was resolved, fixing rust workflow references to prestate builds that were causing errors ([#19228](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19228)). Other work included using a standard pattern for admin RPC in `op-interop-filter` ([#19083](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19083)) and simplifying blob handling in Kona by removing `IndexedBlobHash` usage ([#19081](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19081)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **Reth Updates and Exports:** Several PRs focus on updating Reth to version 1.11.0 ([#19240](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19240)) and exporting `calculate_receipt_root_optimism` in `op-reth` ([#19238](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19238), [#19231](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19231)).
- **Dependency Bumps:** Multiple PRs address dependency updates for various components, including `github.com/docker/docker` ([#19236](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19236)), `lodash-es` and `mermaid` ([#19235](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19235)), `github.com/quic-go/quic-go` ([#19234](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19234)), `github.com/quic-go/webtransport-go` ([#19233](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19233)), `github.com/ulikunitz/xz` ([#19232](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19232)), `github.com/andybalholm/brotli` ([#19226](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19226)), and `github.com/hashicorp/golang-lru` ([#19225](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19225)).
- **Testing and Refactoring:** New tests are proposed to validate interop messages ([#19229](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19229)), and refactoring efforts include introducing `InitMessage` and `ExecMessage` structs ([#19227](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19227)) and migrating `tablewriter` ([#19223](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19223)).
- **Logging:** A chore PR adds logging for Kona safe head alert triage ([#19224](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19224)).

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Supernode Safe Label Adjusting
The issue of "Safe Label Adjusting" in `op-supernode` ([#18976](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18976)) has been closed. This issue focused on how the `op-supernode` manages the `Safe` label across different layers (EL, CL, Superchain) to ensure consistent understanding of the chain state. Discussions highlighted the need for the CL to maintain its own "Local Safe" representation and the supernode's role in controlling the EL's safe and finalized states directly.

### L2 Contract Upgrades Specification
The task to write formal specifications for smart contract changes related to L2CM Upgrades ([#18867](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18867)) has been closed. This involved converting a design document into a formal spec.

## NEW ISSUES

### Interop Upgrade Transaction Migration
A new issue has been opened to migrate Interop upgrade transactions to the NUT bundle approach ([#19239](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19239)). This is necessary to account for upgrade gas and move away from the legacy hardcoded upgrade transaction pattern.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### `op-reth` Database Read Transaction Memory Leak ([#19212](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19212))
The issue describes a recurring problem where `op-reth` nodes on Base mainnet experience a warning: "The database read transaction has been open for too long triggers memory leak," leading to high memory consumption and crashes. The latest comment confirms that this issue is happening repeatedly across all nodes, indicating a persistent and widespread problem that needs urgent attention.
